header.basis: DOK-ING RFI2 short-form replies (2026-11-25) against the registry and the engine
header.note: Display/documentation only. data/equipment_registry.json is not edited and no model reads this file.

items.name: Gasifier Vessel (Reactor)
items.why: RFI2 #1,#3: tubular reactor heated electrically from outside, no carrier loop, no air reactor, no added agent. The twin models an air-blown carrier reactor.

items.name: Gasifier Vessel (Pressure)
items.why: No dependence found on the removed inputs.

items.name: Air/Steam Injection (Flow)
items.why: RFI2 #1,#4: no air or steam is added to the reactor (0 Nm3/h, 0 kg/h).

items.name: Air/Steam Injection (Temp)
items.why: RFI2 #4,#10: no injected air or steam, so no injection temperature or preheat.

items.name: Bed Drain / Ash Discharge System
items.why: RFI2 #9: ash is separated at the reactor exit and removed by a spindle into a separate container, not a bed drain.

items.name: Char / Ash Conveyor
items.why: RFI2 #8: char/carbon black is 40 to 50% of the feed (17 to 21 kg/h), about 10 times the twin's 1.7 to 2 kg/h.

items.name: Char Collection Bin
items.why: RFI2 #8: bin sizing depends on the 17 to 21 kg/h char flow.

items.name: Carbon Black Recovery & Classification Unit
items.why: RFI2 #8: registry capacity 3 kg/h against 17 to 21 kg/h expected.

items.name: Ash Aggregate Processing & Packaging Unit
items.why: RFI2 #8,#9: ash and carbon-black flows differ; it is unclear whether char includes ash.

items.name: Carbon Black Packaging & Storage Silo
items.why: RFI2 #8: silo and packaging sized for 2 kg/h class flow.
